hypothesis: A source-blind TRAIN-fitted covariance policy chooses causal input-pattern observations reducing exact counterfactual forecast Brier loss almost as much as the optimized one-step exact Bayes chooser, with lower whole-process CPU and no peak memory regression.

source_free_only.world: Unknown three-input 8-bit Boolean transition rule; true prior is equal mixture of U uniform 256 rules and C uniform over 16x16x3 latent two-input gate compositions joined XOR/AND/OR, with syntactic multiplicity.
source_free_only.fixture_per_case: 2 previously observed public causal input patterns with truth; 2 disjoint target patterns with hidden counterfactual truth; remaining 4 available intervention patterns; choose exactly 1 intervention, then forecast both targets under same exact posterior.
source_free_only.validation_distribution: Fresh source-free seeds under frozen 50/50 mixture; no prior T16-T42 consumed source identity or case replay.

exact_scientific_objective.utility: Expected conditional reduction in mean Brier loss on TWO disjoint target bits AFTER observing selected intervention pattern, unknown rule from exact 50/50 class mixture. Do not reward revealing the intervention bit; targets are disjoint from selectable interventions.
exact_scientific_objective.exact_formula: sum over both target bits of Cov(rule_bit_action, rule_bit_target given public history)^2 /(2 Var(rule_bit_action given public history)); gain 0 at Var=0. Compute from posterior over all 256 rules, and independently compare with exhaustive two-outcome Bayes risk difference.
exact_scientific_objective.proof: For every validation case compute exact utility of all four actions from same public posterior, prove chosen gain <= optimized exact maximal gain, independently verify covariance identity to tolerance 1e-11, zero hard false certifications.

native_and_loss.primary_learning_condition: Learned policy captures >=99% of aggregate exact optimal expected utility on frozen source-free validation worlds, with zero incorrect certified target answers.
native_and_loss.secondary_genuine_parameter_ablation: Disable TRAIN-fitted cross-pattern covariance and use tie-first intervention on same source-free worlds; selected action or expected utility must differ in at least one validation case.
native_and_loss.fairness: All arms see same public 96 TRAIN rules and 48 validation worlds. Native whole-process includes meta-source generation, training for learned arms, validation source generation, selecting an intervention, exact proof/scoring, intervention observation and exact target forecast. Five separate native process CPU and RSS trials per arm and OS.
native_and_loss.CPU_acceptance: Learned median complete CPU strictly below BOTH optimized exact and cached exact controls on BOTH GitHub-hosted Windows and Ubuntu; peak RSS at or below best comparator per OS. Cache construction and training included.
native_and_loss.stop_rule: Any utility/ablation/certification/native regression fails closed; no new scientific DEV, threshold relaxations, or consumed validation retuning.
